messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: document management system (Sat 9 Nov)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Colleague,

The firm's document management system will be unavailable on Saturday 9 November between 07:00 and 11:00 for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please ensure any documents you are working on are checked in before Friday close of business. Email will be unaffected.

If you have any questions please contact the IT Helpdesk.

Regards,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
